newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Riksbank sets repo at unchanged 4.10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Riksbank sets repo at unchanged 4.10 pct.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, on Tuesday set a new one-week repurchase operation at an unchanged, fixed 4.10 percent.
The market had not expected the bank to make any moves on the repo rate, which is its key tool for controlling money market liquidity.
The repo operation will run from June 25 to July 2.
The bank said primary dealers were invited to submit bids by 0800 GMT on June 24 with the lowest accepted volume 200 million crowns and the highest accepted volume 15 billion crowns.
The repo rate was last moved on December 17 when it was lowered by 25 basis points.
The Riksbank's other key interest rates, the deposit and lending rates, currently stand at 3.75 percent and 5.25 percent respectively.
